question: What is a PRN and why do I need it?
answer: A Payment Registration Number (PRN) uniquely identifies your tax payment. You must quote it when paying at the bank, via mobile money, or online card channels so the payment is matched to your tax account.

question: How do I generate a PRN?
answer: To generate a Payment Registration Number (PRN) on the URA web portal (ura.go.ug): 1) Go to e-Services > Make a Payment > Generate a Payment Slip; 2) Select your payment type (e.g., Income Tax, VAT, Motor Vehicle, Customs, or Stamp Duty); 3) Enter your TIN (or select Non-TIN and enter your NIN/Passport for government agency fees); 4) Enter the exact amount payable in UGX; 5) Click Submit/Generate to receive your 10-digit PRN and download your payment slip; 6) Pay via Mobile Money (*165# on MTN, *185# on Airtel), any commercial bank counter, or online card payment (VISA/Mastercard).

question: Nsobola ntya okukola oba okufuna PRN mu URA?
answer: Okukola nnamba ya PRN (Payment Registration Number) ku mutimbagano gwa URA (ura.go.ug): 1) Genda ku e-Services > Make a Payment > Generate a Payment Slip; 2) Londa ekika ky'omusolo gw'oyagala okusasula (gamba PAYE, VAT, omusolo gw'emmotoka, oba Stamp Duty); 3) Yingiza nnamba yo eya TIN (oba londa Non-TIN oyingize NIN); 4) Wandiika omuwendo gw'ensimbi mu ssente za Uganda (UGX); 5) Koona ku Submit ofune nnamba ya PRN ey'obubonero 10; 6) Sasulira ku Mobile Money (*165# ku MTN, *185# ku Airtel), mu bbanka yonna, oba ne kaada ya VISA/Mastercard.

question: Ninazalishaje nambari ya PRN ya kulipa kodi URA?
answer: Ili kuzalisha Nambari ya Usajili wa Malipo (PRN) kwenye tovuti ya URA (ura.go.ug): 1) Nenda kwenye e-Services > Make a Payment > Generate a Payment Slip; 2) Chagua aina ya kodi au ada unayotaka kulipa (k.m. PAYE, VAT, Kodi ya Gari, au Ushuru wa Stempu); 3) Weka TIN yako (au chagua Non-TIN uweke NIN au Pasipoti); 4) Andika kiasi halisi cha kulipa kwa UGX; 5) Bonyeza Submit kupokea nambari ya PRN ya tarakimu 10 na kupakua hati ya malipo; 6) Kamilisha malipo kupitia Pesa za Simu (*165# MTN, *185# Airtel), tawi lolote la benki, au kadi ya VISA/Mastercard.

question: How do I pay taxes using Mobile Money with a PRN?
answer: To pay URA taxes via Mobile Money: On MTN, dial *165# > select 4 (Payments) > select 1 (URA) > enter your 10-digit PRN > confirm taxpayer name and amount > enter your MoMo PIN to complete. On Airtel Money, dial *185# > select 4 (Pay Bill) > select 7 (URA) > enter your PRN > verify details > enter your Airtel PIN. You will receive an instant SMS payment confirmation from your telecom provider.

question: How long is a PRN valid and how do I reactivate it if expired?
answer: A standard URA PRN is valid for 21 days from the date of generation (or up to 28 days for certain taxes). If a PRN expires before payment, go to ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > Reactivate Expired PRN, enter the expired PRN number, and submit to refresh its validity without creating a new tax declaration.

question: How do I check if my tax payment has reflected after paying using a PRN?
answer: To confirm that your payment has posted to your URA tax account: 1) Go to ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > View Payment Status; 2) Enter your 10-digit PRN and click Search; 3) The system displays the payment receipt, date, bank transaction reference, and cleared status. You can also print the official URA receipt from this page.

question: Where can I pay after getting a PRN?
answer: Use partnered banks, mobile money (by quoting the PRN), or online card payments (Visa/Mastercard) available from the Make a Payment section.

question: Can I pay by Visa or MasterCard online?
answer: Yes. To pay online via card: 1) Go to ura.go.ug or portal.ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > Pay with VISA or Master Card; 2) Enter your 12-digit PRN to retrieve the assessed liability and confirm taxpayer details; 3) Select card payment gateway (VISA / MasterCard / UnionPay); 4) Enter your card number, expiry date, and CVV code; 5) Complete 3D-Secure bank OTP verification; 6) System generates an instant cleared e-receipt and posts funds to your tax ledger.

question: What if my PRN expired?
answer: If your PRN has expired after its 21-day validity: Go to ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > Reactivate Expired PRN, enter the expired PRN number, and submit. The system extends the validity period immediately without requiring a new tax return or declaration.

question: How do I confirm the payment posted?
answer: To confirm a tax payment has posted: Go to ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > View Payment Status, enter your 10 or 12-digit PRN, and click Search. The portal displays the bank transaction reference, payment timestamp, amount paid, and cleared status, with an option to download the official receipt.

question: Can I reprint a payment slip?
answer: Yes. To reprint a payment slip: Go to portal.ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > Print a Payment Slip, enter your PRN or search reference code, complete CAPTCHA, and click Search / Print to download the PDF payment slip with the scannable bank barcode.

question: Can I verify an advance income tax payment?
answer: Yes. To verify commercial vehicle advance tax: Go to portal.ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > Verify Advance Income Tax Payment, enter the vehicle registration number and PRN to confirm payment of UGX 20,000 per passenger seat or UGX 50,000 per tonne for goods vehicles.

question: Is there a way to pay park user fees or hospital fees?
answer: Yes. On portal.ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment, use 'Generate Payment Slip for Park User Fees' to pay for Uganda Wildlife Authority (UWA) park entry and gorilla permits, or 'Pay For Hospital Fees' to generate PRNs for Mulago National Referral Hospital and other public hospitals.

question: How do I pay for Uganda Wildlife Authority (UWA) park user fees on the portal?
answer: To pay UWA park fees: 1) Go to portal.ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > Generate Payment Slip for Park User Fees; 2) Select Uganda Wildlife Authority (UWA) as the agency; 3) Select the national park (e.g. Bwindi, Queen Elizabeth, Murchison Falls) and activity (Gorilla Trekking, Game Drive, Park Entry); 4) Enter visitor details (NIN or Passport); 5) Generate the PRN and pay via Mobile Money (*165# / *185#) or bank.

question: How do I print an Income Tax Certificate on the URA portal?
answer: To print your Income Tax Certificate: 1) Go to portal.ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > Print Income Tax Certificate; 2) Enter your active 10-digit TIN and the relevant tax assessment year; 3) The system verifies cleared payments on your income tax ledger and generates your official printable Income Tax Clearance Certificate.

question: How do I pay public hospital fees on the URA portal?
answer: To pay hospital fees: 1) Go to portal.ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > Pay For Hospital Fees; 2) Select the facility (Mulago National Referral Hospital, Butabika Hospital, Kiruddu, Kawempe, or Regional Referral Hospital); 3) Select hospital department/service; 4) Enter patient name and National ID / NIN; 5) Enter fee amount, generate the PRN, and pay via mobile money or bank counter.

question: How do I download manual payment forms and deposit slips?
answer: To download manual payment forms: Visit portal.ura.go.ug > e-Services > Make a Payment > Download Manual Payment Forms. You can download printable Bank Payment Vouchers, Non-Tax Revenue (NTR) deposit slips, and bulk commercial bank payment schedules to fill in ink and present with cash or cheque at any bank.

question: How do I authenticate or verify a URA payment receipt?
answer: To authenticate a payment receipt: Visit portal.ura.go.ug > e-Services > Document Authentication, select Payment Receipt / PRN Assessment, enter the 12-digit PRN or Payment Reference Number, and complete CAPTCHA to verify genuine payment settlement against the Bank of Uganda ledger.

question: Who can help if a payment fails or is not reflected?
answer: Contact URA support via toll-free 0800 117 000 / 0800 217 000 or WhatsApp 0772 140 000 with your PRN and payment receipt for assistance.
